title: Separate preparations: one component per board

experiments.question: What does this initial component preparation do on a separate board?

provenance.scope: Demonstration of separate initial preparations; no new physical claim.

experiments.title: Receiver alone: stationary prepared memory
experiments.description: One component instance on its own board. A separate run is not a component connected to another board. Zero-counter receiver and guide preparations are stationary by Rule3; this does not test their response to an incoming signal.
